test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Simba and snowy are__ cute__ than the other puppies.
solution:
The correct answer is, '**Cuter**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• There are 3 Degrees of Adjectives - Positive, Comparative, and Superlative.
 
 
• Example, ***Fast (Positive), Faster (Comparative), and Fastest (Superlative)***.
